title: Review each decision of the hand I just played
description:
As a learner, I want a review panel after each hand that grades every decision I made, so that I see straight away which of my plays were right or wrong.

Walking-skeleton slice of the Hand Review panel (Review storyboard: panel beside the table, result and Deal next hand on the table side, Close button in the panel). When a hand ends in which the user made any decision other than folding preflop, the panel opens; it is skipped only when the user's single action in the hand was a preflop fold, so a hand where the user called or raised preflop and then folded preflop opens it (REQ-043.12). In M1 it reads the completed hand exposed by E03-S01 and grades each user decision with the E07-S04 grader on that decision's PlayerView; each entry shows street, board at that point, the user's action, the recommended action and the grade as text (Correct, Minor error, Major error) with its colour badge. Bot decisions are never graded. Explanations, numbers and basis arrive in M2 (E09-S02) once E07-S12 exists: do not show placeholder text for them. While the panel is open the E03-S04 automatic 1.5 s deal is suspended and the next hand waits for Deal next hand.

## Requirements covered
- REQ-024 (Must): Between hands — When a hand ends, TLH Trainer shall show the result, and shall deal the next hand only after the user clicks Deal next hand if the Hand Review panel is open, or automatically after 1.5 seconds if it is not.
- REQ-043 (Must): Hand Review panel — When a hand ends in which the user made any decision other than folding preflop, the Table screen shall open the Hand Review panel beside the table, unless auto-open is turned off in Settings.
- REQ-057 (Should): Accessibility and usability — Every screen shall meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast and control-labelling rules, and every grade or status shown in colour shall also be shown as text.

Covers: REQ-024, REQ-043, REQ-057

## Notes
Gate the same next-hand timer E03-S04 uses; after Close the timer stays suspended until Deal next hand (REQ-043.10).

Plan key: E09-S01 · Dream: limit-holdem-trainer

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a scripted hand in which the user made 4 decisions and the bots made 9, When the hand ends, Then the Hand Review panel opens beside the table with exactly 4 entries in the order made, each showing street, the board at that point, the user's action and the recommended action, and no entry for any bot decision [REQ-043.2]

Given the same scripted hand, When the panel opens, Then each entry's grade equals the E07-S04 grader output for the user's PlayerView at that decision and is shown as the text label Correct, Minor error or Major error, not by colour alone [REQ-057.3, REQ-043.2]

Given a hand in which the user's single action was folding preflop at their first decision, When the hand ends, Then no panel opens and the next hand is dealt 1.5 s after the result is shown [REQ-024.3, REQ-043.12]

Given a hand in which the user is the big blind and every other player folds, so the user made no decision, When the hand ends, Then no panel opens and the next hand is dealt 1.5 s after the result is shown [REQ-024.3]
Given the panel is open, When 10 s pass with no input, Then no next hand has been dealt [REQ-024.2]
Given the panel is open, When the user selects Deal next hand, Then the panel closes and the next hand is dealt with the hand number increased by 1 [REQ-043.7, REQ-024.2]

Given the panel is open, When the user selects Close, Then the panel closes, the hand's result and the Deal next hand control stay visible on the table, and after 10 s no next hand has been dealt until the user selects Deal next hand [REQ-043.7, REQ-043.10]

Given a hand in which the user called $8 preflop and then folded preflop to a re-raise, When the hand ends, Then the panel opens with exactly 2 entries, the call and the fold, and no next hand is dealt until the user chooses [REQ-043.12]

Given the Hand Review panel is open when a hand ends, When the 1.5 s auto-deal would fire, Then useTableSession's holdNextHand holds it, and 'Deal next hand' calls dealNext() (dealHand(nextHand(t), newCode())); the hold remains after Close (REQ-043.10)
